note: Reviewed inventory of every namespace in catalogues.DEFERRED_NAMESPACES: its reason, the render points a human verified as plain-string consumers (no envelope identity), and the per-file reference census that tests/unit/i18n/test_deferred_references.py ratchets. Counts may only fall; a rise or an unlisted file means a deferred namespace gained references. A NEW render point is not automatically a defect: it is an expected, deliberate re-measure — re-verify that the new use is a plain-string consumer, then record it with `python scripts/i18n/deferred_watch.py --write` (the same drift is what `--check` reports). The first such re-measure is core #3143 (`/saver`), which adds wire.radient_saver render points in saver/command.py, exec_startup.py, tui/app.py and slash_commands.py; its counts are NOT recorded here until that code is on main. The alternative outcomes are unchanged: remove the namespace from DEFERRED_NAMESPACES (its catalogue returns to the eager set), or move the use to a listed render point.
